factions.name: Starfleet (United Federation of Planets)
factions.ideology: Exploration, diplomacy, and the betterment of all sentient life
factions.description: The exploratory and defensive service of the United Federation of Planets. Starfleet represents the ideals of cooperation, scientific discovery, and peaceful first contact. Its officers serve on starships and outposts throughout the galaxy, upholding the Prime Directive and defending the Federation from threats.

factions.name: Klingon Empire
factions.ideology: Honor, warrior culture, and strength through conquest
factions.description: A powerful militaristic empire ruled by the Klingon High Council. Klingons value honor above all else, and their warrior culture demands constant proof of bravery in battle. Despite their aggressive nature, they have been both fierce enemies and valuable allies of the Federation.

factions.name: Romulan Star Empire
factions.ideology: Survival through secrecy, deception, and strategic superiority
factions.description: A secretive and powerful empire founded by Romulans who split from Vulcan millennia ago. The Romulans embrace emotion and passion, in contrast to Vulcan logic, but channel it through cunning strategy and deception. Their empire is shrouded in mystery, protected by the Great Link and the Tal Shiar.

factions.name: Cardassian Union
factions.ideology: Order, discipline, and the supremacy of Cardassian civilization
factions.description: An expansionist empire in the Alpha Quadrant that occupied Bajor for 26 years. The Cardassians are a pragmatic and ruthless species that values order and efficiency above all. Their empire was built on conquest and exploitation, but they maintained it through sophisticated bureaucracy and military might.

factions.name: The Dominion
factions.ideology: Absolute control and the perfection of all species through Dominion rule
factions.description: A powerful interstellar empire controlled by the Founders, a shapeshifting species from the Gamma Quadrant. The Dominion encompasses the Changelings (Founders), the Jem'Hadar (warrior drones), the Vorta (supervisors), and the Founders themselves. They waged a devastating war against the Federation-Klingon alliance.

factions.name: The Borg Collective
factions.ideology: Assimilation and perfection through technological and biological integration
factions.description: A hive mind of assimilated beings connected through a vast network. The Borg represent one of the greatest threats in the Star Trek universe, seeking to assimilate all species and incorporate their unique characteristics into the Collective. Individuality is erased; resistance is futile.

military_branches.name: Borg Fleet
military_branches.description: Cube-class and Sphere-class warships

military_branches.name: Assimilation Teams
military_branches.description: Borg drones that board enemy vessels to assimilate crews

factions.name: Bajor (Bajoran Provisional Government)
factions.ideology: Faith, independence, and resilience after occupation
factions.description: A small planet that suffered 26 years of Cardassian occupation before regaining its independence. The Bajorans are a deeply spiritual people who worship the Prophets (the 'Gods'), which are actually alien beings residing in the Bajoran wormhole. Despite their small size, Bajor plays a pivotal role in Alpha Quadrant politics.

factions.name: The Maquis
factions.ideology: Resistance against perceived Federation betrayal of border worlds
factions.description: A paramilitary group composed of citizens from Federation border worlds that were ceded to the Cardassians in a peace treaty. The Maquis believe the Federation abandoned them and fight against Cardassian reoccupation. Some members are former Starfleet officers.

factions.name: Romulan Resistance
factions.ideology: Freedom from the Praetor and Tal Shiar tyranny
factions.description: Dissident groups within the Romulan Star Empire seeking to overthrow the corrupt Praetor and Tal Shiar regime. These resistance movements operate in secret, risking execution if discovered.
